name: GraphicsProbe
author: Dominik
description: Experimental read-only rendering snapshots. Ctrl+Shift+F8; reports in UserData/GraphicsProbe/latest.json. In-Game-Verify open.
manualTrigger: Ctrl+Shift+F8 (game focused; selected uGUI/TMP text-input guard)
limitations: Bounded SceneManager-enumerable loaded scenes only; DontDestroyOnLoad may be outside scope. Lexical candidates are unconfirmed; no main-camera or depth-buffer guarantee.
removal: With game closed, remove Mods/GraphicsProbe.dll and optional PDB; optionally delete UserData/GraphicsProbe. Keep Shared and other mods.
